list.name: serial
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT serial_number FROM devices ORDER BY serial_number

list.name: circuit
list.label: Circuit
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat(group_idx, '_', circuit_idx) AS __value, concat('Group ', group_idx, ' Circuit ', circuit_idx) AS __text FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' ORDER BY 1

list.name: price_per_1000kwh
list.label: Price per 1000 kWh ($)
list.description: Substituted directly into SQL as a number -- enter a plain numeric value (e.g. 150), not currency-formatted text.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cs.time AS "time", cs.watts * CASE WHEN COALESCE(cc.invert_display, false) THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS "value", concat('G', cs.group_idx, ' C', cs.circuit_idx) AS metric FROM circuit_samples cs LEFT JOIN circuit_config cc ON cc.serial_number = cs.serial_number AND cc.group_idx = cs.group_idx AND cc.circuit_idx = cs.circuit_idx WHERE cs.serial_number = '$serial' AND concat(cs.group_idx, '_', cs.circuit_idx) = '${circuit:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(cs.time) ORDER BY cs.time

panels.title: Circuit Usage & Cost (set price in the "Price per 1000 kWh" box above)

targets.rawSql: WITH deltas AS (SELECT cs.group_idx, cs.circuit_idx, cs.watts * CASE WHEN COALESCE(cc.invert_display, false) THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS watts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cs.time - LAG(cs.time) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.group_idx, cs.circuit_idx ORDER BY cs.time))) AS dt_seconds FROM circuit_samples cs LEFT JOIN circuit_config cc ON cc.serial_number = cs.serial_number AND cc.group_idx = cs.group_idx AND cc.circuit_idx = cs.circuit_idx WHERE cs.serial_number = '$serial' AND cs.time >= date_trunc('day', now())) SELECT concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS "Circuit", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0)::numeric, 3) AS "kWh", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0 * (${price_per_1000kwh} / 1000.0))::numeric, 2) AS "Cost ($)" FROM deltas GROUP BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY group_idx, circuit_idx
